description:
Revoke Fast Pool STX delegation from your Pillar smart wallet (pox-4 revoke-delegate-stx; refused while pox-4 is not the active PoX contract). Agent-signed, no browser needed. Backend sponsors gas. After revoking, STX stays locked until the current PoX cycle ends, then returns to liquid.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: pillar_direct_revoke_fast_pool
